rule: the object is fetched on demand and never committed; every derived value names this hash
donor and condition are parsed from sample_id, the only field that carries them; the donor is the independent unit
celltype_v2 -> epithelium/stroma/myofibroblast; only epithelium and stroma are primary
the frozen measurement_features only; absent features are recorded, never aliased
donor x condition x compartment pseudobulk f and detection d with within-donor bootstrap intervals; cells are never replicates
RR01-RR12 and RR14; the ADOC donors can never define the high state
external per-cell high-state definition -> fraction of the unit's cells in that state -> initial probability under the declared ensemble-frequency bridge; a 0 or 1 is unresolved, never written
a later unit writes `<node>.istate` only, on a shared v0.5.1 topology, and records every value's stage 1-7 identities
no outcome label (adhesion, pregnancy, secretion, model output) selects a reference, statistic or threshold
one topology shared by every donor; Phase 2A writes no .bnd or .cfg
a feature used to personalize a donor cannot later be cited as independent validation of that donor's model on the same feature without a declared validation design
